tool_signatures.name: connect_app
tool_signatures.description: OPTIONAL preflight. Every app-taking tool (query_tree, click, fill, screenshot, ...) connects on its own, so you do NOT need to call this first. Call it to (a) check an app is reachable through Accessibility before driving it, (b) see exactly how a fuzzy name resolved, or (c) warm up an Electron app

readyTimeoutMs.description: Electron accessibility-tree readiness timeout in milliseconds

tool_signatures.name: end_activity
tool_signatures.description: End an interaction-indicator scope started by begin_activity. Pass the token that begin_activity returned. Safe to skip if the client disconnects; the daemon expires abandoned scopes on its own.

tool_signatures.name: extract_text
tool_signatures.description: Extract text from an app window using OCR (Vision framework). Bridges accessibility gaps in apps with poor AX support. Pass either an app name to capture + OCR, or base64 PNG data to OCR directly.

app.description: App name or PID (captures a screenshot and runs OCR)

data.description: Base64-encoded PNG image to OCR directly (alternative to app)

region.description: Optional region to restrict OCR (only with app, not data)

tool_signatures.name: fill
tool_signatures.description: Set the text value of a field. Auto-waits for the element to appear. On Electron/web content, the default

tool_signatures.name: get_element
tool_signatures.description: Find a specific UI element and return its properties (role, title, value, enabled, focused).

tool_signatures.name: list_apps
tool_signatures.description: List running macOS apps, split into the ones that are currently reachable through the Accessibility API and the ones that are running but will fail to connect (launchers, helper processes, apps that never implement AX). Blocked entries carry the AX error code, what it means, and what to do instead.

tool_signatures.name: list_daemon_methods
tool_signatures.description: List every JSON-RPC method registered by the daemon. Used to verify that daemon capabilities are exposed through MCP.

tool_signatures.name: list_menu_bar
tool_signatures.description: Return a menu-only Accessibility view. query_tree already includes menus, so use this only when that menu section was omitted, truncated, or a compact menu-only result is needed.

tool_signatures.name: list_shortcuts
tool_signatures.description: List all Apple Shortcuts available on this Mac.

input.description: Input text to pass to the shortcut

tool_signatures.name: list_skills
tool_signatures.description: List available macbeth skills. Each skill has instructions (SKILL.md) and optional runnable scripts.

tool_signatures.name: list_windows
tool_signatures.description: List open windows across macOS Spaces without touching an accessibility tree.

tool_signatures.name: load_skill
tool_signatures.description: Load a skill by name. Returns the SKILL.md instructions and lists any runnable scripts.

tool_signatures.name: pin_handle
tool_signatures.description: Pin an element handle to prevent it from expiring (default TTL is 5 minutes). Useful for long-running workflows where you need a stable reference to a panel or control.
